RegisterSteps:
1. Join the Nostalgia Discord.
2. Type in the channel: {0} <name>  (letters and digits only)
3. The bot shows your account name and password – copy both into the launcher.
RegisterNote: Accounts are only created by the Discord bot (one per Discord user). The password is random – keep “Remember login” on and you never have to type it.
HintIntro: The login was probably refused. The client shows the reason in the top-left corner of the loading screen (above “Hit ESC to exit game.”):
HintWrongPassword: “Your password is incorrect.” – wrong password: type {0} on Discord and enter the new password here.
HintNotLinked: “Your account has no access to this game.” – account unknown or not linked to Discord: check the account name, otherwise contact a GM on Discord.
HintServerOffline: Only “Hit ESC to exit game.” without a reason – no answer from the server: it is offline or restarting. Watch the status at the top right.
HintServerOfflineNow: Only “Hit ESC to exit game.” without a reason – the server is offline right now (status at the top right). Try again later.
LaunchFailedText: connect.exe was started, but the game did not appear. Common causes: an antivirus blocked connect.exe (it modifies the game process in memory), .NET Framework 4 is missing, or the client folder is incomplete. Copy the support info and ask on Discord.

PrivacyText:
What the server stores: your Discord ID and your account name (linked by the Discord bot, one account per Discord user), the password only as a hash, plus the usual game data (characters, login times, IP address at login).

What the launcher stores on this PC ({0}):
• login.dat – account name and password, encrypted by Windows (DPAPI, only your Windows account can read it). “Switch account / sign out” deletes the file.
• settings.json – client folder, notices you have read.
• manifest-cache.json – server address and news.
• logs – logs of the last days, without the password.

The launcher sends nothing except: fetching the manifest (GitHub), the status check of the login port, update downloads, and – when you press Play – account name and password to the Nostalgia server (encrypted, HTTPS) to fetch the quickbar layouts of the Master Trainer. When the game starts, the client receives account name and password as start parameters (visible to other programs of your Windows account).
QuickbarsCloseGame: Close the game first, then press Play again.
QuickbarsLogInOnce: Log in with {0} once, log out, then press Play again.
QuickbarsUnavailable: Quickbars could not be checked (no answer from the server) – the game starts as usual.
QuickbarsLoginFailed: Quickbars could not be checked (login refused) – the game starts as usual.
QuickbarsWriteFailed: Quickbars for {0} could not be written (details in the log) – they stay ready for the next Play.
QuickbarsAckFailed: The server did not confirm – they will be set up again on the next Play.
